5612-6927-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5612-6927-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2645-5640-7935.description:
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, targeting Gumato.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Staff of Domination's ability, targeting Gumato.
Resolve the first Staff of Domination ability, untapping Gumato.
Holding priority, activate Gumato by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Resolve the second Staff of Domination ability, untapping Gumato.
Activate Gumato by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3899-4677-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

567-728-1981-2415.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
567-728-1981-2415.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

618-4681-5231.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide with haste.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

618-997-4681.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide with haste.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the other Angel on the battlefield

3259-7175-7917--185.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7175-7917--185.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-7175-7917--185.notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then Lavaleaper can be omitted.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-7824-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating six 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Ojer Taq and Bard.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
1270-7824-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 7^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 42 after the first iteration, 294 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

2060-2232-7838--177.description:
Cast the creature that's castable for {G} in your hand by paying its mana cost
Necklace of Girion triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the creature spell. When the creature enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the other creature that's castable for {G} from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2232-7838--177.notes: The chosen creatures that are castable for {G} cannot be artifacts, otherwise they will not trigger Cloudstone Curio. They also must be green in color (which may be relevant in cases of devoid creatures).

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3388-5241.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3388-5241.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Moritte of the Frost and Sakashima's Student each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3388-5241.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

6723-7296-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
6723-7296-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
6723-7296-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1432-1636-5371-7629.description:
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Hourglass of the Lost.
Repeat.
1432-1636-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

774-3756-6763.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers.
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Izzet Boilerworks's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1020-2866-4050-5060.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact and a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
1020-2866-4050-5060.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding one mana of any color.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Cemetery Prowler.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding one mana of any color.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Cemetery Prowler.
Repeat.

338-2557-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-2557-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

777-1805-4331-4993.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2511-5170-5933-6132.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2034-4766-5229-7091.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ulamog, adding {C}{C}.
When Ulamog dies, it, Heirloom Blade and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Ulamog trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Heirloom Blade trigger, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature that shares a card type with Ulamog and put it into your hand
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Activate Heirloom Blade's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the creature.
Repeat.
2034-4766-5229-7091.notes: The returned creature may be Ulamog or not. If it isn't, simply ignore the trigger shuffling it into your library, and replace all instances of Ulamog with the returned creature for that iteration.

1479-2841-4488-6158.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-2841-4488-6158.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a stun counter on it

514-654-5944-6797.description:
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' third ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Amulet of Vigor.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
When Unstoppable Slasher enters, Amulet of Vigor and The Mycosynth Gardens trigger, untapping Unstoppable Slasher twice, which will instead remove both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 2.

972-3542-6991.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-3542-6991.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is an artifact.
When the Palinchron token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Donnie & April by paying its mana cost.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Donnie & April and the Palinchron token.
Put the Donnie & April token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April and Palinchron tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-3542-6991.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Palinchron and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Donnie & April instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

874-1170-1329-4894.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-4894.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Delif's Cone.
Cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Breaching Hippocamp.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

141-2292-6933.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2292-6933.description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Incarnation Technique.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3661-3967-5220-6900.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2173-3944-5220-6794.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2390-2919-5793.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give All Will Be One lifelink.
You have a way to gain life.
2390-2919-5793.description:
Give All Will Be One lifelink, if needed.
Gain life in any way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

2829-5362-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
You have enough mana to cast Quantum Misalignment
2829-5362-5365.description:
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat from step 2.
2829-5362-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

2232-2785-3593-4336.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Mardu Warshrieker onto the battlefield.
Mardu Warshrieker and Cloudstone Curio each trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Warshrieker trigger, adding {R}{W}{B}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep to your hand.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Mardu Warshrieker to your hand.
Repeat.

914-3504.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3504.description:
Cast Mercurial Pretender by paying {4}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Dockside Extortionist.
Mercurial Pretender enters the battlefield, creating at least ten Treasure tokens.
Activate nine Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mercurial Pretender by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

168-4753-4948-5290.description:
Cast Estrid's Invocation by paying {2}{U}.
Estrid's Invocation enters the battlefield, triggering Sage of Mysteries and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Estrid's Invocation's trigger, becoming a copy of Oblivion Ring and exiling Oblivion Ring.
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield, triggering Sage of Mysteries and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator's trigger, becoming a copy of Estrid's Invocation and exiling Estrid's Invocation.
Estrid's Invocation leaves the battlefield, returning Oblivion Ring from exile to the battlefield.
Sage of Mysteries and Oblivion Ring triggers.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Oblivion Ring's trigger, exiling Clever Impersonator.
Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield, returning Estrid's Invocation from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3263-3764.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pincher, adding {C}{C}.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
